evaluation_scope: Incremental external-source probe adding paraphrased direct AND/OR evidence and two conjunction near-misses. This is a smoke-test extension, not a representative benchmark, calibration set, or production policy test.
confidence_semantics: raw uncalibrated model self-assessment, not event probability

predictions.gate_evidence_quote: Resistor 1 must fail in Mode A and Resistor 2 must fail in Mode B in order for the system failure or accident to occur.
predictions.reason: The source explicitly states that both child failures must occur together for the parent event, so the gate is AND.

predictions.gate_evidence_quote: all events m thru z must occur (fail)
predictions.reason: The source directly states that all listed child events must occur for the parent gate, indicating an AND relationship.

predictions.gate_evidence_quote: if any of the events m thru z occur (fail), event k occurs
predictions.reason: The text directly states that if any event from m through z occurs, event k occurs, indicating that any one child can independently cause the parent, so the gate is OR.

predictions.gate_evidence_quote: the coexistence of all input events is required to produce the output event
predictions.reason: The source explicitly states that all input events must coexist to produce the output, which directly indicates an AND relationship.
The source only lists possible causes and does not directly state whether any one cause alone can lead to inconsistent tracking or whether multiple causes must jointly occur.
The source text only states that pressure and temperature increased before rupture; it does not specify whether both increases were jointly necessary or whether either alone could cause rupture.

limitations: This extension has six nodes from five source documents; two gate labels share the same CARE III manual and therefore are not independent source clusters.
Several positive controls are explanatory gate definitions rather than independently validated real-system fault trees; they test text interpretation, not domain fault-tree completeness.
The possible-cause-list sample uses the official NASA NTRS abstract because that record exposes no downloadable PDF.
The Apollo 13 near-miss is intentionally conservative: the quoted chronology reports two co-occurring states before rupture, not a proof that the physical mechanism had no Boolean relation.
Labels were assigned by the primary AI role reviewer before model inference; they are not human expert Gold or independent second-agent findings.
Model self-reported scores are uncalibrated and cannot be interpreted as event probabilities or used as production thresholds.
This extension does not test source-document extraction, cause completeness, recursive tree generation, formal gate-policy selection, database integration, or production readiness.
